description: Call the CanaryLLM gateway (canaryllm.canarycoders.es) — a multi-provider LLM API for chat completions, image/video/audio/music/dialogue generation, vision (object & face detection, custom model training), conversational AI agents, and drop-in OpenAI/Anthropic/Responses-compatible endpoints. Use this whenever the user wants to hit CanaryLLM / CanaryLLM API / the canary gateway, generate media through it, point an existing tool or SDK at it, or write code/scripts that call any canaryllm.canarycoders.es endpoint — even if they don't paste the spec. Knows the async queue (submit → poll) workflow that the native endpoints require, the Bearer-token auth convention, and which endpoints are synchronous vs queued.
